shared_elements: schematic curvilinear figures in low relief
repeated motifs arranged in rows/registers on a stone surface
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic, curvilinear low-relief motifs including rounded/ring elements and crouching or curled anthropomorphic-zoomorphic forms repeated across the field, and the outline-with-bulging-relief convention is broadly comparable. However, A is a horizontal panel of repeated profile crouching figures with no dominant figure, whereas B organises its motifs on the body of a single upright anthropomorphic form, with a face, a belt-like band and paired discs in fixed anatomical positions \u2014 a compositional scheme with no counterpart in A.
